PART I: SECTION (I) — GENERAL
Government Notifications
2nd Amendment
Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service

THE Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Education Administrative Service published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1928/28 dated 21st of August, 2015 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as amended by the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1956/16 dated 01st of March, 2016 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka is amended as follows and these amended provisions will be made effective from 26th of February, 2019, the date on which the Cabinet of Ministers made the policy decision.
By order of the Public Service Commission,

M.A.B. DAYA SENARATH, Secretary Public Service Commission 03rd September, 2019. 10.1.1 (i) Should have completed at least six (06) years of active and satisfactory period of service in Grade III of the category of service and earned six (06) salary increments.

(i) Should have completed at least six (06) years of active and satisfactory period of service in Grade II of the category of service and earned six (06) salary increments. (v) Should have demonstrated a performance at satisfactory level or above during six (06) years immediately preceding the date of promotion in accordance with the approved procedure of performance appraisal. The following note will be included below the qualifications referred to under 10.2.1. Note: The officers who are to be promoted to Grade II and have completed the qualifications referred to in the amended 10.1.1 as at 26th of February, 2019, the date on which the Cabinet of Ministers made the policy decision and the officers who were promoted to Grade II prior to such date will be promoted to Grade I from the date they complete a period of 12 years of active and satisfactory service in Grade III and II and all other qualifications referred to under 10.2.1 excluding the qualification in 10.2.1(i). 10-15
